parsed.scene_description: An indoor retail aisle with ceiling-mounted fluorescent lights and hanging paper lantern decorations. Tall shelving units on the left hold rows of bottled products. In the center, stacked boxes and a shopping cart filled with beverages are visible near bright windows. A metal stand or rack stands to the right.

objects.label: ceiling light fixture
objects.observation: Long rectangular fluorescent light mounted on black ceiling beam, positioned above left shelving unit.

objects.label: paper lantern decoration
objects.observation: Yellow and white striped spherical paper lantern hanging from ceiling beam near left.

objects.label: shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall metal shelving on left side containing multiple rows of bottled personal care products.

objects.label: shopping cart
objects.observation: Wire shopping cart filled with blue and green beverage bottles, positioned near center-right.

objects.label: stacked boxes
objects.observation: Multiple cardboard boxes stacked on floor and pallets in central area near windows.

objects.label: metal stand
objects.observation: Tall black metal frame or rack standing on right side of aisle near counter.
